title: Nonuniform dichotomies via time rescaling
summary: We establish characterizations of general nonuniform dichotomies for linear nonautonomous dynamical systems in terms of nonuniform exponential dichotomies of appropriately time-rescaled systems. In discrete time, for a class of slowly growing rates, such a characterization requires an additional condition involving a suitable notion of nonuniform ordinary dichotomy, which can be omitted for invertible systems.
